ELECTRON AND CHROMIUM

Nova runs on Electron {electron} (https://github.com/electron/electron),
which contains Chromium {chrome} and Node.js. Electron's licence is in
LICENSE.electron.txt, and the licences of Chromium and of the parts it
contains are in LICENSES.chromium.html, both next to this file and
exactly as Electron ships them:
  LICENSE.electron.txt    sha256 {electronLicenseSha256}
  LICENSES.chromium.html  sha256 {chromiumCreditsSha256}
